title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), several SECURITY DEFINER functions in the pem schema of the PEM backend database…
description: Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM) contains several SECURITY DEFINER functions in the pem schema of its backend database that are owned by a superuser but do not set a safe search_path. This allows any PEM user who can connect to the backend database to create objects that these functions use instead of the intended ones, enabling execution of arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges. This issue affects all supported PostgreSQL versions via temporary objects and additionally affects PostgreSQL 14 backends and those upgraded from PostgreSQL 14 via objects in the public schema. Starting from PEM version 10.6.1, these functions have been updated to run with a fixed search_path, mitigating the vulnerability.
